positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: SmartDrive Systems was acquired by Omnitracs, September 2020.

positions.title: Marketing and Events Assistant
positions.description:
• Coordinated production of DEW Expo & LA Games Conference, including registration for over 1,700  senior executives, press outreach, sponsorships, site updates, and panel set up for speakers from companies such as Google, Facebook, Blizzard, and Microsoft
• Secured over 20 media partners by negotiation and managed relations by keeping track of deliverables schedule and ensuring execution of partnership terms
• Launched Facebook advertising campaign with $600 budget to drive traffic to event website and reached 30,000  in target market within 1.5 months
• Reduced company overhead cost by $500/month by implementing efficient methods of generating current digital media news for daily newsletters
•  Managed social media content on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn to retain and increase followers
• Managed website’s advertising campaigns for company newsletter and website
• Composed daily news on WordPress, social media, and sent out to over 13,000 newsletter subscribers via MailChimp
• Promoted client’s webinar for 2 weeks through email blasts and social media and attained 50 attendees
• Identified potential customers through Saleforce and reached out via email to generate ticket sales

positions.title: Business Office Assistant at International Trade Education Program
positions.description:
• Reported directly to company’s CEO, COO, and Finance & HR Administrator, coordinated meeting materials, and handled sensitive information with discretion
• Supported Communications Manager, Finance & HR Administrator, Development Associate, and Program Managers
• Efficiently multitasked bookkeeping, filing, data entry (106 WPM), scheduling, telephone/front reception, spreadsheets, reports, office organization, and administration
• Created flyers, business cards, updated website, and edited documents for CEO, COO, and Communications Manager
• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn organization processes with minimal supervision
• Praised by COO and Finance for high learning curve, timeliness, and quality of work

positions.title: Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
•	Performed Market Analysis on AirTight Networks, AppNeta, and Compuware to determine their online presence to choose a new social media outlet to increase brand awareness in the Asian-Pacific market 
•	Analyzed multiple forums, blogs, and IT magazines such as CNet, Network World, and Computerworld to select which platform and what topics would work best with the target market

positions.title: Digital Marketing Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
•	Advised nonprofit Shakti Rising in a team of 3 on their digital marketing strategies with SEO, PPC, social media marketing, and conversion design that prompted them to simplify their site maps for visitors to easily navigate through their website
•	Redesigned current intern page on company website using WordPress, linking each intern’s picture to their LinkedIn profile to simultaneously promote current interns and increase attractiveness of internship to prospective interns
•	Promoted internship program through social media marketing and campus tabling, recruiting 6 out of the 23 applicants 
•	Mentored at-risk youths during their digital marketing training by providing feedback on their business projects

positions.title: Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
•	Increased attendance to launch event by reaching out to 83 current and potential clients via phone and email
•	Optimized bilingual abilities to overcome language and cultural barriers with co-workers, management, and guests
•	Designed invitations and raffle poster for promotion and to create incentives for guests to attend the launch event

projects.title: ShareCrow
projects.description:
Digital marketplace for users to rent and lend out items with payment security.
• Designed and implemented integral marketplace and user account React views and data visualization components
• Created an intuitive and seamless UX design through implementation of SASS, Bootstrap, and React
• Framed complex relational schema interactions using PostgresSQL to facilitate user connections

projects.title: Memowise
projects.description:
A customizable gamified flash card application.
• Integrated Facebook OAuth using Passport 
• Designed and built a responsive UI with Material Design
• Integrated a gamification component to extend long-term usage to achieve competitive drive for users

organizations.name: Delta Sigma Pi - Omicron Sigma Chapter
organizations.position: Vice President of Community Service, Webmaster · Mar 2012 - Present
organizations.description: Delta Sigma Pi is a professional fraternity organized to foster the study of business in universities; to encourage scholarship, social activity and the association of students for their mutual advancement by research and practice; to promote closer affiliation between the commercial world and students of commerce, and to further a higher standard of commercial ethics and culture and the civic and commercial welfare of the community.
